<h4 class="mb-3 h3">Immersing Us Into New Worlds</h4>
<p><strong class="text-uppercase">No Margin for Error</strong>: The most high-stakes work people do, from innovative surgery to emergency landings, has to be simulated before it happens.</p>
<p><strong class="text-uppercase">She Built the Field</strong>: Carolina Cruz-Neira co-invented the CAVE in 1992, the immersive VR system now used by NASA, the U.S. military, automotive manufacturers and research labs around the world.</p>
<p><strong class="text-uppercase">Defining What’s Next</strong>: From her lab at UCF’s Institute for Simulation and Training, she’s leveraging humanoid robots that extend immersive systems into places humans can’t reach, from disaster zones to deep space.</p>
